hookups.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530483 (site details of all 37 'Campsite Electric' sites: sites 101-126 'Electricity Hookup: 50/30', sites 202-206 and 219-223 '20', host site 201 '30'; 'Water Hookup: Y' at every one; 'Sewer Hookup: Y' only at the host-designated sites 101, 126 and 201), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 37 electric RV/tent sites in two campgrounds. Campground 1 (sites 101-126, 26 sites) takes rigs to 40 ft, 8 of them pull-through; Campground 2's 11 electric sites (201-206, 219-223) are capped at 15 ft. Sites 101, 126 and 201 are marked Host, so 24 public sites take a 23-ft rig. 12 walk-in tent, 8 river platform and 8 backcountry sites besides.

sites.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530483 (every site's Max Vehicle Length / Driveway Entry); https://gastateparks.org/ChattahoocheeBend ('37 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites', '12 Tent Walk-In Campsites', '8 Platform Campsites', '8 Backcountry Campsites'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://gastateparks.org/sites/default/files/parks/pdf/trailmaps/parkmaps/chattahoochee%20bend%20sp%202022%20map.jpg (Campground 1 inset: restrooms, showers and laundry icons at the comfort station, dump station at the entrance; Campground 2 inset: restrooms, showers, laundry); https://gastateparks.org/ChattahoocheeBend ('Bathhouses with hot showers are a short walk from most campsites'), read 2026-10-29

booking.source: https://gastateparks.org/ChattahoocheeBend ('Make a Reservation' -> Georgia State Parks' ReserveAmerica site, parkId 530483; every campsite bookable there), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $32 a night for an electric/water back-in site, $36 for a pull-through or a host-designated site; the same on a weekday and a Saturday (November 2026, June 2027). Walk-in tent and platform sites $20, backcountry $11. Vehicles need the $10 ParkPass. Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530483 (1-night prices for every site on 2027-06-15; sites 102 and 103 also on 2026-11-10 and 2027-06-19: $36.00 and $32.00 Per Night), read 2026-10-29

note: RVs go in Campground 1 (sites 101-126); Campground 2's electric sites are short tent/pop-up pads. The riverfront platform and walk-in sites are tent-only. Boat ramp on the Chattahoochee; the river is ~200 m north of Campground 1 through woods. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on gastateparks.org + ReserveAmerica + the park map: 37 electric sites (water; 50/30 A in Campground 1, 20 A in Campground 2; sewer only at 3 host sites), 24 public sites take 23 ft (40 ft max), 8 pull-throughs; $32 back-in / $36 pull-through, weekday = Saturday; showers, laundry, dump. Phone 770-254-7271 matches. Fees note corrected ('full hookups $36' was wrong: $36 is the pull-through price, no public site has sewer). Pin is ~2.4 km off (see flag). Note trimmed of counts/hookups/booking/ParkPass.

Website lists three URLs; the bare https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com is redundant beside the parkId=530483 deep link. Suggest https://gastateparks.org/ChattahoocheeBend plus the deep link.
